name: Dragons Xmas Dig
description:
We have acres and acres of land to go at this brand new farm located in the historic town of Much Marcle.
On the old maps and such, we are detecting on the farm that belonged directly to the old castle, which was a manor, upgraded to a castle and is now again once a manor house. Now, before all of that, that manor predates the Domesday book, of which it is mentioned. Straight up fact about this manor house; when William the Conqueror won the battle of Hastings in 1066, he gifted this manor to his standard bearer, William de Lacy. This is extremely historic ground!
We have loads of hardstanding. We have loads of land of which is a mixture of cover crop and pasture. We have loads of mince pies, Irish coffee, bacon rolls (yes, they're back). We will also have a competition for the best Xmas hat. We will also have a token hunt for some Christmas goodies!
Recce was productive with lots of targets and no green waste. The more we get on here, the more we'll open up; simple as that!
Usual stuff. £20 per digger, spade carriers and U16s are free. NCMD insurance or equivalent is required. Unfortunately, no dogs allowed due to livestock. Treasure acts to be followed and tidy hole filling at all times.
Arrival from 0888 for a 0900 start
